occurrences.key: Verifier Git trace is observer evidence. It does not prove all agent commands were captured, absence of transient write-and-restore behavior, continued isolation during the entire live run, or causality of caller changes. Git status counts cannot attribute the one change to a particular actor. No script's presence is treated as execution evidence, and an individual Git exit 0 is not promoted into an aggregate verification or acceptance verdict.
